title: security: RBAC v2 policy + KMS region-pinning audit enhancements
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Context: This PR implements enhancements to RBAC v2 to support explicit KMS region-pinning rules and improve audit logging for data residency enforcement. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require deterministic key-residency guarantees and a clear audit trail when non-compliant requests are blocked or remediated. This change ties RBAC policy evaluation to KMS residency metadata, surfaces why requests were rejected in audit logs, and adds guardrails to prevent accidental cross-region key usage. Changes: 1) RBAC policy schema extended with optional 'kms_residency' constraint (allow/deny + region list); 2) Enforcement layer in the auth service now fetches key residency from the KMS metadata cache and evaluates it during authorization checks; 3) Audit logging now includes structured fields (policy_id, evaluated_constraints, kms_key_region, request_region, decision_reason) and emits both human-readable and JSON messages to the audit pipeline; 4) New feature flag 'rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce' to allow staged rollout (audit-only -> enforce); 5) Updated unit/integration tests and added a Linear-linked regression test harness. Checklist: - [x] Schema changes (rbac/v2/policy.proto + JSON schema) - [x] Enforcement in auth service - [x] Audit log field additions and pipeline mapping - [x] Feature flag and toggle in config service - [x] Backwards compatibility tests - [x] Docs + migration guide - [x] Security review and threat modelling notes Commits: See commit summary below. Rollout plan: Feature flag default set to 'audit-only' on main. Ops will enable enforcement for affected tenants after a 48h monitoring window once deployed to production. Migration notes: Existing policies without kms_residency behave as before. Admins can add kms_residency blocks to deny cross-region keys or require specific regions for data types. Related: ENG-4523 covers the policy UX work in Console, SEC-212 covers the threat modelling action items.

d4e5f6g: evaluate kms residency in auth authorize flow, add cache lookup and fallback rules

release_notes: Add optional KMS region-pinning constraints to RBAC v2 policies and enhanced audit logging for residency enforcement. Feature gated behind rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce (audit-only by default).
